meta.name: alphagenome
meta.description: Look up precomputed AlphaGenome Atlas effects for any GRCh38 single-nucleotide variant (AVI score with Phred and 18 SHAP feature attributions, plus raw and quantile scores for RNA-seq, DNase, ATAC, ChIP-TF, ChIP-histone, CAGE, PRO-cap, splicing, polyadenylation and contact-map tracks), score variants or scan windows on demand with the AlphaGenome model for human and mouse (variant scoring, in silico mutagenesis, REF-versus-ALT track prediction), and build Atlas website deep links. Use when the user mentions AlphaGenome, AlphaGenome Atlas, AVI or AlphaGenome Variant Impact, DeepMind variant effect prediction, or wants to prioritise or mechanistically interpret non-coding, regulatory, splicing, enhancer, promoter, or chromatin-accessibility effects of SNVs from a VCF, credible set, or region. Research use only; not a clinical tool.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入变异位点，得到基因调控、剪接与染色质影响的评分
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在研究非编码区变异如何影响基因调控与剪接。
copy.tagline_en: Score any GRCh38 variant's regulatory, splicing, and chromatin effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study how non-coding variants affect gene regulation.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查任意 GRCh38 单核苷酸变异的 AlphaGenome Atlas 预计算结果:AVI 分数、Phred、18 项 SHAP 归因,以及各 track 的原始与分位分数;也能按需用模型给人和小鼠的变异打分、扫描窗口,并生成 Atlas 网站深链。
howto.when: 当你提到 AlphaGenome、AVI(AlphaGenome 变体影响)或 DeepMind 变体效应预测,或想对 VCF、可信集、区域里的非编码、调控、剪接类 SNV 做优先级排序和机制解读时触发。
